name: happy_path
description: Renter qualifies fully and agrees a viewing. Reaches Qualified / Appointment Set.
opening: Hello, am I speaking with the person enquiring about a rental in Gurugram? This is Asha calling from the rentals team.

turns.lead: Yes that's me. I was expecting a call.
turns.agent: Thank you for taking the call. So I can shortlist properly, what monthly budget are you working with?

turns.lead: We're looking at about forty five thousand up to sixty thousand a month, not more than that.
turns.agent: Understood, forty five to sixty thousand a month. And which areas work for you?

turns.lead: Sector 82 mainly, Sector 84 would also be fine. We need three bedrooms, semi furnished is enough.
turns.agent: Noted. Let me see what I have available for you.
I have a three bedroom at A-702, Palm Grove Heights in Sector 82. Semi furnished, forty seven thousand a month, deposit is two months. Pets are allowed there with a society NOC.

turns.lead: That sounds about right. What is the maintenance like, is it heavy?
turns.agent: I don't have the maintenance figure confirmed for that tower, so I won't guess. I'll check with the owner and come back to you on it.

turns.lead: Fair enough. Can we see it this Saturday morning?
turns.agent: Yes, Saturday at eleven works. I'll book that in for you now.

turns.lead: Perfect. Send me the address on WhatsApp please.
turns.agent: I'll send you the details and the exact location after this call. Thank you for your time, I'll see you on Saturday.

args.text: Prefers weekend morning viewings and wants details on WhatsApp.
